occupancy: Sharing varies by hall: Vasishtha is single-seater, Aryabhatta and Vivekananda are triple-seater, Panini (PG) is single/twin-seater, Maa Saraswati (girls) offers triple and single rooms.
messNote: Each hall runs its own mess overseen by wardens and a student mess committee; a separate campus cafeteria serves food from 2 pm to midnight for students wanting options outside mess hours.
